prompt:
Create one isolated 32x32 pixel art equipment inventory icon of a compact deployable solar panel assembly for a scientific Mars rover in Mars Crafts.

Show two rectangular dark navy photovoltaic panel surfaces attached to a small central light gray metallic hinge and mounting bracket.

Use a clearly readable grid of dark blue solar cells with restrained cyan highlights, thin pale steel borders, compact mechanical joints and a tiny industrial orange engineering accent.

Three-quarter product presentation view with the upper surface and a small front-facing edge visible. Upper-left lighting, dark lower-right shading.

Authentic refined 16-bit Game Boy Advance pixel art, clean dark outlines, limited industrial space technology palette, visually consistent with the existing Mars Crafts rover and spacecraft UI.

Center the complete component inside a 32x32 transparent canvas with small even margins.

One item only. No rover, no ground, no interface button, no frame, no text, no background, no realistic gradients, no antialiasing.
